description: Implemented adapter-owned preflight, ten-file post partitioning, request-size batching, thread continuations, and partial-delivery metadata. ZAQ forwards full lists and max_file_size unchanged, projects delivery_report generically, records each confirmed post, and stores canonical continuation history idempotently. Verified Mattermost 179 unit tests passed, ZAQ 66 targeted tests passed, both quality gates passed. Docker live tests: 15x1KiB ->10+5 with root_id verified; edit existing ->10+5 threaded; nine valid plus oversized ->nine and one failure; fetched all new-post files and compared bytes. No commit or push. Live test post udoo83oi7in6pkqdtqknywp3wh; edit roka3kks4pd1deuqkk5hgho6pc.
title: Consume adapter-owned multi-post delivery reports
